role_in_project: Secondary Cross-Validation Benchmark for Breaking Change Taxonomy
selection_rationale: Selected as Dataset #2 to cross-validate our breaking change taxonomy. While Java library changes operate on bytecode and signatures, their underlying mutation semantics (parameter requirement tightening, return type shifts, method deletion, precondition assertion) directly mirror OpenAPI structural and behavioral breaking changes. This demonstrates our NLP engine's classification aligns with established empirical software engineering literature.
